integrity: All exact count experiments use standard-library integer arithmetic; proof uses formal power series and symmetry of grid axes; no external certification.
scientific_limitations: Uncoloured simple 2-dimensional Cartesian grids P_m square P_n, m,n>=2, uniform initial vertex colour. No conclusion for other graph products or initial colourings. Finite tests do not replace all-parameter proof.
title: Exact colour-refinement depth of rectangular grid graphs
